info.title: Polymarket WebSocket API
info.description:
Real-time WebSocket streaming API for Polymarket prediction-market data.

## Connection
Connect to `wss://api.struct.to/ws` using a standard WebSocket client.

## Authentication
An API key is required. Pass it via **header** or **query parameter**:

**Header (recommended):**
```
X-Api-Key: <your-api-key>
```

**Query parameter (browser / frontend):**
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws?api_key=<your-api-key>
```

The query parameter is only used when no `X-Api-Key` header is present.

## Joining a room
After connecting, send:
```json
{"type":"join_room","payload":{"room_id":"polymarket_trades"}}
```

## Subscribing
After joining, send a `room_message` with room-specific subscribe payload:
```json
{
"type": "room_message",
"payload": {
"room_id": "polymarket_trades",
"message": {"action":"subscribe","condition_ids":["0xabc…"]}
}
}
```

## Keepalive
Send `{"type":"ping"}` periodically to keep your connection alive. The server responds with `{"type":"pong"}`. Connections that have not sent a `ping` within **60 seconds** are closed.

alerts.description: WebSocket alerts endpoint — ephemeral real-time alert subscriptions. Pass API key via ?api-key= query parameter. Subscribe/unsubscribe by sending JSON messages. Subscriptions are ephemeral and end on disconnect.

polymarket_trades.title: Trades
polymarket_trades.description:
Real-time stream of Polymarket prediction-market events (trades + oracle lifecycle). Supports both confirmed (on-chain) and pending (mempool) trades.

**Filters (optional):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs (with or without `0x` prefix)
- `market_slugs` — market slugs
- `event_slugs` — event slugs (delivers all markets under each event)
- `position_ids` — ERC-1155 token IDs (decimal or hex)
- `traders` — trader wallet addresses
- `trade_types` — optional allowlist (e.g. `["OrderFilled", "Resolution"]`). Omit or pass `[]` for all types.
- `status` — `"confirmed"` (default), `"pending"`, or `"all"`

If no filters are provided, subscribes to ALL trades (open-ended).

**Pending trades:** Fields unavailable from mempool (`block`, `confirmed_at`, `log_index`, `block_index`, `order_hash`, `taker`, `fee`, `fee_shares`, `fee_pct`) are omitted. `received_at` (ms) is included instead.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"` to clear all subscriptions.

polymarket_asset_prices.title: Asset Prices
polymarket_asset_prices.description:
Real-time crypto-asset price feed (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, …). Delivers both raw `asset_price_tick` events on every price update and `asset_price_window_update` events at candle open/close boundaries.

**Filter (optional):** `asset_symbols` — uppercase symbols to filter by. Empty array subscribes to all symbols.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_asset_window_updates.title: Asset Window Updates
polymarket_asset_window_updates.description:
Filtered stream of asset-price candle open/close events. Unlike `polymarket_asset_prices`, this room **requires** at least one filter so clients receive only the symbols and/or timeframes they care about.

**Filters (at least one required):**
- `asset_symbols` — uppercase symbols (e.g. `"BTC"`, `"ETH"`)
- `timeframes` — candle sizes: `"5m"`, `"15m"`, `"1h"`, `"4h"`, `"1d"` / `"24h"`

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_market_metrics.title: Market Metrics
polymarket_market_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics per market condition, aggregated across multiple timeframes (`1m`, `5m`, `30m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`, `7d`, `30d`). One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs. Invalid or malformed IDs are returned in `rejected`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_event_metrics.title: Event Metrics
polymarket_event_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics aggregated at the event (parent market group) level, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `event_slugs` — event slugs (lowercase).

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_position_metrics.title: Position Metrics
polymarket_position_metrics.description:
Real-time volume, trade-count, and OHLC price/probability metrics per outcome-token position, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `position_ids` — ERC-1155 token IDs (decimal or hex).

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_pnl.title: Trader PnL
polymarket_trader_pnl.description:
Real-time profit-and-loss updates for tracked traders, delivered at global, market (condition), and event granularity.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Events pushed:** `trader_global_pnl_update`, `trader_market_pnl_update`, `trader_event_pnl_update`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_positions.title: Trader Positions
polymarket_trader_positions.description:
Real-time position updates for tracked traders. Streams full position snapshots whenever a position PnL changes.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Events pushed:** `trader_position_update` — includes PnL fields, shares balance, market slug, outcome, and all enriched data.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_accounts.title: Accounts
polymarket_accounts.description:
Real-time balance updates for Polymarket wallet accounts.

Always streams ERC-1155 outcome token (shares) balance changes for subscribed wallets as `accounts_update` events. Opt in to additional token streams via boolean flags:
- `include_usdce: true` — also receive `usdce_update` events (USDCe collateral balance)
- `include_matic: true` — also receive `matic_update` events (MATIC gas balance)

**Filter (required):** `wallets` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_order_book.title: Order Book
polymarket_order_book.description:
Real-time CLOB orderbook snapshots for Polymarket outcome tokens. Each event contains the full aggregated bid/ask book plus pre-computed derived metrics (best bid/ask, mid price, spread, USD liquidity depth, level counts).

**Filters (at least one required, max 500 combined):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs (market); delivers snapshots for all positions in that market
- `position_ids` — hex token/asset IDs (individual outcome tokens)

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_clob_rewards.title: CLOB Rewards
polymarket_clob_rewards.description:
Real-time stream of Polymarket CLOB reward configuration changes. Emits events when rewards are added to a market, removed, or updated (e.g. rate changes, sponsor count changes, spread/size threshold changes).

**Filters (optional):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs to watch for reward changes
- `subscribe_all` — set to `true` to receive ALL reward changes across all markets

If neither is provided, no events are delivered.

**Event types:**
- `added` — new reward configuration appeared on a market
- `removed` — reward configuration removed from a market
- `updated` — reward parameters changed (rate, spread, size, sponsors, etc.)

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

ws_alerts.title: WebSocket Alerts
ws_alerts.summary: Ephemeral real-time alert subscriptions over WebSocket
ws_alerts.description:
Connect to `wss://api.struct.to/v1/ws/alerts?api-key=<key>`. Subscribe to webhook-style alert events by sending JSON messages. Subscriptions are ephemeral and end when the connection closes. The alerts WS path shares the same event/filter pipeline as HTTP webhooks; only delivery transport differs. Credits cost matches the corresponding webhook event.

**Supported events:** trader_first_trade, trader_new_market, trader_whale_trade, trader_new_trade, trader_global_pnl, trader_market_pnl, trader_event_pnl, condition_metrics, event_metrics, position_metrics, market_volume_milestone, event_volume_milestone, position_volume_milestone, probability_spike, price_spike, market_volume_spike, event_volume_spike, position_volume_spike, close_to_bond, market_created, asset_price_tick, asset_price_window_update

Each subscribe/unsubscribe request is typed per event and reuses the matching webhook filter schema. Server acknowledgements use `{"op":"subscribed"|"unsubscribed", ...}`, and pushed alert events use `{"event":"...","timestamp":...,"data": ...}`.

AssetPriceWindowUpdateFilters.description: Subscription filters for the `asset_price_window_update` event. All fields are optional.

asset_symbols.description: Restrict to these crypto assets. Empty = all assets.

timeframes.description: Restrict to these candle sizes. Empty = all sizes.

AssetPriceTickFilters.description: Subscription filters for the `asset_price_tick` event. All fields are optional.

asset_symbols.description: Restrict to these crypto assets. Empty = all assets.

MarketCreatedFilters.description: Subscription filters for the `market_created` event. All fields are optional.

tags.description: Restrict to markets with these tags or category names (case-insensitive match).

condition_ids.description: Restrict to these specific markets.

event_slugs.description: Restrict to markets belonging to these events.

exclude_shortterm_markets.description: When `true`, suppress webhooks for short-term "updown" markets (event slugs containing `updown`). Default: `false`.

CloseToBondFilters.description: Subscription filters for the `close_to_bond` event. At least one of `min_probability` or `max_probability` is required.

min_probability.description: Trigger when the YES outcome price is ≥ this value (e.g. 0.95 for 95% certainty). At least one of `min_probability` or `max_probability` must be set.

max_probability.description: Trigger when the YES outcome price is ≤ this value (e.g. 0.05 for near-certain NO).

condition_ids.description: Restrict to these markets.

position_ids.description: Restrict to these outcome token IDs.

event_slugs.description: Restrict to markets in these events.

position_outcome_indices.description: Restrict by outcome index. 0 = Yes/Up, 1 = No. Position 0 usually represents the Up/Yes side in binary markets.

exclude_shortterm_markets.description: When `true`, suppress webhooks for short-term "updown" markets. Default: `false`.

PositionVolumeSpikeFilters.description: Subscription filters for the `position_volume_spike` event. `spike_ratio` is required.

spike_ratio.description: **Required.** Multiplier threshold (must be > 1.0). Fires when current volume >= snapshot × ratio.

window_secs.description: Force snapshot reset after this many seconds (max 600 / 10 minutes).

position_ids.description: Restrict to these outcome token IDs.

condition_ids.description: Restrict to positions within these markets.

TradesStreamSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the trades stream. No filters = subscribe to all trades.

condition_ids.description: 64-char hex condition IDs (with or without 0x prefix)

event_slugs.description: Event slugs — subscribes to all markets under each event

position_ids.description: ERC-1155 outcome token IDs (decimal or hex strings)

trade_types.description: Only receive events of these types. Empty array = all types.

status.description: Trade status filter: "confirmed" (default) = on-chain only, "pending" = mempool only, "all" = both

subscribe_all.description: Explicitly subscribe to all trades. Also implicitly true when no filters are provided.

TradesStreamSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for a trades stream subscription

rejected.description: Filter values that were rejected (invalid format or unknown type)

TradeStreamEvent.description:
Server-pushed event. Discriminated by `trade_type` — each variant only includes relevant fields.

Envelope: `{"type": "trade_stream_update", "room_id": "polymarket_trades", "status": "confirmed"|"pending", "data": {...}}`

**Pending trades:** `block`, `confirmed_at`, `log_index`, `block_index` are absent. `received_at` (milliseconds) is included instead. For OrderFilled/OrdersMatched, `order_hash`, `taker`, `fee`, `fee_shares`, `fee_pct` are also absent.

position_ids.description: Token / asset IDs (individual outcome positions, hex strings).

asks.description: Ask levels sorted best-first (lowest price first)

rewards_min_size.description: Min order size to qualify for rewards

WebhookDeliveryEnvelope.description: Outer envelope for every webhook HTTP POST delivery. The `data` field contains the event-specific payload. Delivery headers sent with every POST: `X-Webhook-ID` (subscription UUID), `X-Delivery-ID` (this attempt's UUID), `X-Event-Type` (event name string, e.g. `trader_first_trade`), `X-Attempt` (attempt number, 1-indexed). When the webhook has a secret configured, `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hmac-hex>` is also included — compute HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body using your secret to verify.

id.description: UUID of this specific delivery attempt (matches X-Delivery-ID header)

event.description: Event name (e.g. `trader_first_trade`). On test deliveries the suffix `_test` is appended.

data.description: Event-specific payload — schema varies by event type; see the individual callback definitions

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this delivery was created

webhook_id.description: UUID of the webhook subscription that fired (matches X-Webhook-ID header)

attempt.description: Delivery attempt number. 1 = first attempt; increments on each retry.
